'''Carnus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] who served [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] inside his [[Nem'ro's Palace|Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Be polite, Carnus. This bounty hunter has been sweeping the filth from my town's lovely streets. Excuse him, he lacks manners.|[[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro the Hutt]], to Carnus and the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:BC" />}}
[[File:Nemro_throne_room.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Carnus near Nem'ro's throne]]
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Carnus was seen inside the Palace where he stood patiently at Nem'ro's side when an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified bounty hunter]] arrived to earn the sponsorship for Nem'ro in the upcoming [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. When the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was tasked to hunt down [[Huttsbane]] as the first target, Carnus warned the Hunter that Huttsbane was a skilled warrior that had killed at least one Hutt in his attacks against Nem'ro's people.<ref name="TOR:BC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carnus is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:BC" /> He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
